name: MarkMonitor AnyCA REST Gateway Plugin
description: MarkMonitor plugin for the AnyCA REST Gateway framework

ca_plugin_config.name: ApiKey
ca_plugin_config.description: The API Key for the MarkMonitor API

ca_plugin_config.name: Username
ca_plugin_config.description: Username for the MarkMonitor API service account

ca_plugin_config.name: Password
ca_plugin_config.description: Password for the MarkMonitor API service account

ca_plugin_config.name: BaseUrl
ca_plugin_config.description: The Base URL for the MarkMonitor API - Usually either https://api.markmonitor.com

ca_plugin_config.name: OrgId
ca_plugin_config.description: The name of the MarkMonitor Organization to use for the API calls (ex: MarkMonitor). You can also use the Organization ID in GUID format.

ca_plugin_config.name: Enabled
ca_plugin_config.description: Flag to Enable or Disable gateway functionality. Disabling is primarily used to allow creation of the CA prior to configuration information being available.

enrollment_config.name: CertificateLifetimeDays
enrollment_config.description: The desired lifetime, in days, of the issued certificate. Used by MarkMonitor to create the `not_before_time` and `not_after_time` fields in the signed X.509 certificate. If the lifetime extends past the life of any CA in the issuing chain, this value will be truncated.

enrollment_config.name: AdditionalEmails
enrollment_config.description: List of 0 or more comma separated email addresses to send the certificate to via email after generation.

enrollment_config.name: MarkMonitorGroup
enrollment_config.description: The name or GUID of a MarkMonitor group to use for the certificate request.

enrollment_config.name: MarkMonitorContact
enrollment_config.description: The name or GUID of a MarkMonitor contact to use for the certificate request.

enrollment_config.name: OrganizationName
enrollment_config.description: Name of the organization to be validated against

enrollment_config.name: DCVMethod
enrollment_config.description: The method to use for Domain Control Validation (DCV). Valid values are EMAIL, DNS, or HTTP.
